# truenas_iscsi_target_extent (Data Source)

Looks up exactly one existing `iscsi.targetextent` object by `id` or `query_filters`. Secrets are not exposed.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Identifier of the object to read.
- `query_filters` (String) Middleware query filters as JSON, e.g. `jsonencode([["path", "=", "/mnt/tank/x"]])`. Must match exactly one object.

### Read-Only

- `extent` (Number) ID of the iSCSI extent to associate with the target.
- `lunid` (Number) LUN ID to assign or `null` to auto-assign the next available LUN.
- `target` (Number) ID of the iSCSI target to associate with the extent.
